senses.gloss: to make willing, to prompt. Tanḥ. T’rum. 3 (ref. to Ex. XXV, 2) יצא … שאין לבו נוֹדְבוֹ this excludes the insane whom his heart (reason) cannot prompt; (Tanḥ. ed. Bub. ib. 2 שאינו מתנדב בלבו).—2) (denom. of נְדָבָה) to offer willingly, donate, consecrate, contrad. to נָדַר (v. נְדָבָה).
units: ib. I, 1) תני נ׳ בנזיר וכ׳ read nadab (in place of nadar), he made a noble vow &c. Ib. 10ᵃ תני נוֹדֵב וכ׳ read nodeb (in place of נודר), he dedicates the sacrifice and fulfills (offers it).

<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 1:10">Meg. I, 10</cite> <he>כל שהוא נידר ונ׳</he> whatever sacrifice is dependent on vow or dedication; <cite ref="Zevachim 117a">Zeb. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>כל הנדר ונ׳</he> Ms. M.; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 65">Sifré Deut. 65</cite>; <cite ref="Temurah 14b:35">Tem. 14ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Temurah 14b:33">Ib.</cite> <he>נזיר לאו נדר ונ׳ הוא</he> the sacrifices of the Nazarite are not to be classified among the vowed or free-will offerings; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be prompted; to vow a free-will offering; to donate.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Nedarim 1:1">Tosef. Ned. I, 1</cite> <he>אין הרשעים מִתְנַדְּבִים</he> wicked men do not vow offerings.
<cite ref="Tosefta Nedarim 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מתנדבים נזירות</he> used to vow to be Nazarites.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 12:3">Men. XII, 3</cite> <he>לא ה׳ כדרך המתנדבים</he> he did not make his vow in the ordinary way of vowing people.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 12:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>מִתְנַדֵּב אדם וכ׳</he> a man may vow a meal offering of sixty &c. Tanḥ. ed. Bub. l. c. <he>מתנדב בלבו</he> is prompted by his heart, v. supra.

<cite ref="Arakhin 6b">Arakh. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>עכו״ם שה׳ מנורה וכ׳</he> if a gentile donated a lamp to a synagogue. Sifra Tsav, Milluim, Par. 1 <he>בשעה שצוה … להִתְנַדֵּב וכ׳</he> when the Lord of the world ordered free-will donations for the sanctuary; <he>שלא יִתְנַדֵּב אדם גזל וכ׳</he> that no man must donate what is forced out of him, i.e. no pressure may be used for contributions for a sacred purpose; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 515">Yalk. Lev. 515</cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 43a:10">Snh. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>נשים … מִתְנַדְּבוֹת וכ׳</he> worthy women … volunteered their services and brought them (benumbing drinks for the culprits); a. fr.
